channel.title: Leon's workshop — projects
channel.description: A collection of experiments in making everyday life a little more considered. Built with curiosity, refined by using them.

item.title: Fieldnotes
item.description: A quiet place to collect the things you notice. An exploration of a personal notebook that connects short observations, saved places, and photographs. Designed around a simple daily writing habit.

item.title: Tempo
item.description: Make room for focus, one session at a time. A focus timer concept with deliberate breaks, a gentle progress indicator, and a history of completed sessions. Fewer controls, more space to think.

item.title: Common ground
item.description: A neighborhood guide made by its neighbors. A community directory concept for independent shops, small events, and favorite local places. An experiment in useful, human-scale discovery.

item.title: Spectrum
item.description: Color combinations worth keeping around. A color collection experiment exploring contrast, unexpected pairings, and how a palette changes the feeling of a familiar interface.

item.title: Shelf
item.description: Your next good read, already waiting. A personal reading-list concept that organizes books by mood and curiosity instead of an endless chronological queue.

item.title: Waypoint
item.description: Take the interesting way home. A walking-route experiment about making familiar neighborhoods feel new. Collect a few landmarks and build a walk around them.
